name: [Ψ]Circuit Sense (C)
description:
Extend your electrokinetic senses into the flow of current itself, feeling how electrons want to move through wire and silicon.  While maintained, you understand electronics as though far more practiced: your effective Electronics skill is raised by 3 for crafting, repair, and anything else that tests it.  It does NOT make you craft faster -- only more capable, and only at electronics.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
//: ORIGINAL Bright Nights fork power (NOT upstream MoM). Electronics-only skill buff. Logic in lua/mom_eoc.lua (EOC_ELECTROKIN_CIRCUIT_SENSE_*) + lua/mom_hooks.lua (cast-marker handler, effect-removed handler, learner). The +3 is carried by the hidden trait MOM_CIRCUIT_SENSE (mutations/traits.json) via mut_enchantments SKILL_LEVEL_ELECTRONICS -- BN auto-registers that value from the SKILL_LEVEL suffix list, and get_skill_level() reads it (character.cpp). No speed component: BN crafting speed is global-only, cannot be scoped to one skill (user chose the pure electronics-skill version, 2026-07-13).
Cast marker: applied on cast; mom_hooks' effect_added handler runs EOC_ELECTROKIN_CIRCUIT_SENSE_INITIATE.
Maintained buff presence. EFFECT_LUA_ON_REMOVED -> mom_hooks strips the hidden +3 trait MOM_CIRCUIT_SENSE whenever this ends (re-cast, concentration break, or expiry).
name: Circuit Sense
desc: Your electrokinetic senses are tuned to the flow of current; you read electronics with a practiced eye (+3 effective Electronics skill).
remove_message: Your sense of the current fades; electronics look ordinary again.

name: [Ψ]Lightning Strike
description:
Call down a focused bolt of lightning onto a single target you can see, dealing heavy electric damage at long range.  As your skill grows the strike broadens: at power level 9 and beyond it also lashes everything in the ring of tiles immediately around the point of impact.  The thunderclap is louder than a gunshot.

Range, damage, and (from level 9 on) blast radius all increase with power level.
//: ORIGINAL Bright Nights fork power (NOT in upstream MoM).  The fork's single signature Electrokinetic ranged attack, replacing the cut Static Touch + Voltaic Strikes (2026-07-12 retune).  Plain target_attack, no Lua.  aoe 0 -> 1 first at level 9: aoe = min_aoe + round(level * aoe_increment), capped at max_aoe; round(9*0.06)=1, round(8*0.06)=0.

name: [Ψ]No Go Zone (C)
description:
Project a telekinetic cordon that refuses to let anything crowd you.  While maintained, creatures cannot hold a tile adjacent to you -- the field shoves them back a step the instant they close.  They can still lurk one tile beyond and reach or shoot at you; they simply cannot get in your face.

This power is maintained by concentration and may fail if concentration is interrupted.
//: ORIGINAL Bright Nights fork power (NOT in upstream MoM).  Hand-authored -- logic lives in lua/mom_eoc.lua (EOC_TELEKIN_NOGOZONE_*) and lua/mom_hooks.lua (cast-marker handler + on_every_x tick + learner).  Schema mirrors the generated maintained-power spells (see spells/teleportation.json teleport_reactive_displacement).
Cast marker: applied to the caster on cast; mom_hooks' effect_added handler runs EOC_TELEKIN_NOGOZONE_INITIATE.  Same shape as the generated mom_cast_* markers.
Maintained buff: while present, mom_hooks on_every_x shoves adjacent non-allied monsters out to range 2.
name: No Go Zone
desc: A telekinetic exclusion field holds enemies at bay, preventing them from closing to melee range.
remove_message: The exclusion field collapses; the space around you is open again.

name: [Ψ]See Mechanisms
description:
Open your inner eye to the hidden workings of a lock: the pins of a deadbolt, the wards of a padlock, the tumblers turning behind a safe's dial.  Seeing the answer isn't the same as acting on it, though -- picking a door still takes a lockpick in your hand and a few moments' work, guided so surely it can never fail or trip an alarm.  A safe's dial, once you've read it, just needs your hand to turn it the right way the first time -- no tool, no time at all.

Affects one MECHANICAL lock at a time, right next to you: a keyed or deadbolt door, a barred door, a chain gate, a dial safe, a mechanical gun safe, or a locked display case.  It has no purchase on electronic locks and card readers -- a circuit has no moving mechanism to see.
//: ORIGINAL Bright Nights fork power (NOT in upstream MoM).  Clairsentient utility: guaranteed-success mechanical lockpicking + safecracking, single-target, adjacent-only (2026-08-15 redesign -- the original area-sweep let 'seeing' a lock also silently open it with no tool and no distance limit, which is the exact telekinesis-flavored bug this rewrite removes).  Logic in lua/mom_hooks.lua (cast-marker handler 'mom_cast_clair_see_mechanisms' -> see_mechanisms_pick, which uses gapi.choose_adjacent_highlight to pick ONE target, then branches: doors need a real LOCKPICK-quality item and a timed ACT_LOCKPICK-typed Lua activity; safes need nothing and resolve instantly).  BN can't run map terrain/furniture edits from spell JSON, and lockpick_result isn't exposed to Lua, so the locked->unlocked remap is a hardcoded table mirroring each terrain/furniture's own lockpick_result (safes use their crack/pry result f_safe_o).  Electronic locks are deliberately left to the Electrokinetic's MOM_HACK bridge -- clean path separation.  Single-level power: max_level 1, since neither branch has anything left for mastery to scale once learned.  Follows the circuit_sense/nogozone fork template otherwise: target_attack applies a mom_cast_* marker (EFFECT_LUA_ON_ADDED), STAMINA cost, scale_int, no magic_type.
Cast marker: applied to the caster on cast; mom_hooks' effect_added handler runs see_mechanisms_sweep, then consumes the marker.  Same shape as the other mom_cast_* markers.

name: [Ψ]Mass Hydrothermosis
description:
Reach out with your mind and, in a single instant, bring the fluids inside every creature you can see to a violent boil.  Blood, lymph, insect ichor, hydraulic fluid, coolant, machine oil -- if it flows, it flashes to steam.  Nothing burns and no ground catches fire; the heat happens entirely INSIDE your targets, all at once.

This strikes <color_yellow>every hostile creature in your line of sight</color> -- however far you can see is however far it reaches, which is what makes it a capstone.  It has no purchase only on the truly fluidless (see-through drones like eyebots are borderline) and on nether-null horrors your power cannot touch at all.  Your own companions are spared.  Damage grows with your mastery.

The cost is punishing; you will not cast this twice in a row.

Level 6 leads to Crucible with Conflagration 10 + Mass Hydrothermosis 6 + Molten Land 14 OR Conflagration 10 + Flamethrower 10 + Mass Hydrothermosis 6.
message: You reach into every creature in sight and boil them from within!
//: ORIGINAL Bright Nights fork capstone (NOT upstream MoM).  REPLACES DDA "Hellfire" (pyrokinetic_aoe_blast) -- id deliberately KEPT so it inherits Hellfire's auto-learn slot + prerequisite tree (gen_learn_map) and stays a valid prereq for Crucible (pyrokinetic_incineration); the native Hellfire spell + its self-immunity helper are cut in strip_spell_math DROP_SPELLS.  BN has no "all monsters in LOS" spell shape, so this is a marker+Lua bridge: a self target_attack applies mom_cast_pyrokinetic_aoe_blast (EFFECT_LUA_ON_ADDED); mom_hooks' handler runs U.mass_hydrothermosis (iterate gapi.get_all_monsters, keep hp>0 + friendly==0 + you:sees(pos) + not PSI_NULL, deal per-target rng heat via U.deal_flat_damage crediting the caster) then fires the per-cast attunement/cost events.  Follows the circuit_sense/nogozone/see_mechanisms fork template.  Cost/casting-time mirror the ported Hellfire (STAMINA, 9000->6000, scale_int).  NO fd_fire, NO self-immunity, NO fixed radius.
sound_description: the wet sizzle and burst of boiling fluids!

//: Cast marker: applied to the caster on cast; mom_hooks' effect_added handler runs U.mass_hydrothermosis, fires the per-cast events, then consumes the marker.  Same shape as the other mom_cast_* markers.

Hand-written because the parent spells are GENERATED and their effect_str is set by strip_spell_math's _rewrite_quell_fire*, which means the usual effect_on_condition marker autogeneration never runs.

The player power reuses its existing pyrokinetic_quell_flames_self sub-spell as the relay; the monster spell had no extra_effects, so it gets this one (hit_self -> lands the marker on the caster monster, whose on_mon_effect_added fires the same handler).  `hit_self` is the BN fake_spell key, NOT `self`.
